title: A Phase 2 Study on the Safety and Efficacy of the Anti-BAFF-R Monoclonal Antibody, ESG206, in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Phase 2 Study on the Safety and Efficacy of the Anti-BAFF-R Monoclonal Antibody, ESG206, in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
summary: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II study designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESG206 in participants with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE).
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (≥18 years of age) with a confirmed diagnosis of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
* Evidence of active disease at screening
* Willing and able to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have other autoimmune diseases that may interfere with the assessment of SLE
* Prior or recent use of prohibited immunomodulatory therapies
* Clinically significant infections, malignancies, or uncontrolled medical conditions
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding

primary.m: SLE Responder Index (SRI)-4 response rate at Week 25 compared with placebo
